title: Remote-viewed Martian pyramids as hibernation chambers
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of Remote-viewed Martian pyramids as hibernation chambers, about about a million years ago at Mars, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: these pyramidal places are like hibernation Chambers they're trying to survive until somebody comes to save them

plain: Joe McMoneagle, who says he worked as a remote viewer, someone who tries to see distant places or times using only the mind, tells podcast host Jesse Michels what he says he saw when viewing Mars as it was about a million years ago. He says pyramid-shaped structures there were like hibernation chambers, where beings were trying to survive until someone came to rescue them, which, if true, would mean Mars once held intelligent life.
